final_response:
**Registration desk specification v2, October 4, 2026.** Current phase: registration. Preserve the supplied warm, compact visual treatment while making person lookup, unfinished registration work, and the next registration action clear.

Sources: images 1–6 for liked component treatments, image 7 for overall structure, and the requested corrections. Exact tokens, fonts, icon library, and existing runtime behavior are unknown; reuse the application’s corresponding components when implementing.

The approved corrections can proceed. The meaning of **clear in-progress work** needs a decision before that control is implemented.

| Source | Keep / remove / change / add | Acceptance check |
|---|---|---|
| Image 1 | Keep the sidebar’s icon-and-label treatment and active navigation styling. Remove the selected item’s notification dot. | Registration desk remains identifiable as current; no dot represents selection. |
| Image 2 | Keep Escalations and Desk help treatment. | Same compact outlined actions; no new help features. |
| Image 3 | Keep Record donation treatment. | Preserve its existing action and appearance without inventing payment behavior. |
| Image 4 | Keep labeled name, phone, and optional email fields, Search Records, and form clearing. Remove Filter: All Attendees. | No filter dropdown or replacement tabs/chips. |
| Image 5 | Keep the unfinished-work card treatment and existing Continue/Edit actions. Add View all in progress. | Every unfinished registration in the existing authorized scope is reachable. |
| Image 5 | Add a clear mechanism after its effect is decided. | Its object, scope, effect on saved work, and recovery are explicit. See D1 below. |
| Image 6 | Change selected rows to an even border on all four sides. | No thick left accent; checked state and keyboard focus remain distinct. |
| Image 6 | Remove Query: Test. | No decorative query chip; entered criteria remain visible in the form. |
| Image 7 | Remove Synced to event sheet. | No routine sync destination in the operator interface. |
| Image 7 / instruction | Profile only at bottom left. | One account home in the desktop layout. The supplied full screen does not visibly contain the reported top-right duplicate. |
| Image 7 | Remove Checked In and In Queue counters. | Neither counter appears in registration. |
| Image 7 | Remove Name / Phone, Scan QR, and Family ID tabs. | Keep the existing lookup fields; remove the entire mode strip. |
| Image 7 | Remove printer and badge stock panel. | No replacement hardware/status panel. |
| Current-phase instruction | Remove check-in-only content throughout the screen. | No Quick Check-In action, In Queue row badge, Badge printed badge, or badge-print instruction in the footer. |

The reading order and layout are:

1. **Sidebar and utility header.** Preserve the event identity, sidebar geometry, and existing navigation that serves registration. Keep the location context and liked Escalations/Desk help controls. Place the sole profile control at the bottom of the navigation surface.
2. **Registration desk heading.** Keep the heading and Record donation action. Remove both check-in counters. Suggested supporting copy: “Find a person and complete their registration.”
3. **Lookup and unfinished work.** On wide screens, retain the larger lookup form on the left and the In progress panel on the right. Keep the form’s paired fields, visible labels, search action, and contextual guidance. Do not fill the space vacated by the filter or printer panel.
4. **Results.** Use the existing full-width rows below the lookup region. Retain meaningful identity details, existing registration status, waiver/payment requirements, View, Edit, and Complete waiver where applicable. Keep a truthful result count and existing permitted sorting/selection behavior. Do not hard-code reference names, counts, amounts, or identifiers.
5. **Selection actions.** Show the existing selection bar only when records are selected. Retain Clear selection and Continue with selected. Continuation must enter the existing registration flow. Replace the badge-print instruction with registration-specific wording, such as “Continue registration for the selected people.”

**View all in progress** belongs within the In progress panel, adjacent to its heading or immediately below the preview cards. It opens an expanded view of the same authorized unfinished-work set, using the same card treatment and existing Continue/Edit actions. Include a visible **Back to registration desk** control. Returning preserves the lookup values and selection. Viewing or leaving this list does not cancel or delete saved work. Do not add filters, exports, bulk deletion, or a spinner for work waiting on a person.

**Needs approval before build:** D1 remains unresolved. “Clear” could dismiss a displayed card, abandon a draft, or delete a saved record. Recommended proposal: **Clear from this panel** dismisses one preview card while retaining the saved registration in View all in progress; Continue can resume it. This proposal is not approved, and no destructive effect or undo capability should be assumed. Confirm the intended object and saved effect before implementing this control. Form clearing and Clear selection remain separate operations.

**Other scope notes:** Fast Track has no confirmed registration meaning. Reports and Cash close also lack a confirmed role in this phase. Preserve existing behavior when project sources establish that role; do not build, rename, or silently repurpose those features from screenshots alone. QR lookup, Family ID lookup, check-in/queue operations, badge printing, printer health, and badge stock remain later-phase notes without placeholder UI or hidden implementation.

The affected states should behave as follows:

| State | Required behavior |
|---|---|
| Initial / cleared search | Keep the lookup form available; clear only lookup criteria and their derived results, not saved registrations or unfinished work. |
| Searching | Show truthful “Searching…” feedback when needed and prevent duplicate requests. |
| No matches | Explain that no records match and leave criteria editable. |
| Search failure | Keep entered criteria and provide a usable retry action. |
| Zero unfinished registrations | Show a concise empty state; no fabricated count, saved time, or completion claim. |
| One / many unfinished registrations | Show actual records and outstanding registration tasks; View all reaches the full permitted set. |
| Selected / keyboard-focused | Checked checkbox plus even row border indicate selection; keyboard focus remains independently visible. |
| Save failure / unsaved work | Explain the affected action and recovery. Preserve valid values where supported; warn before losing unsaved work. |
| Partial failure / denied access | Keep unaffected work usable; show a contextual error and existing safe exit. |

On narrower screens, stack lookup, In progress, and results in that order. Stack paired form fields when needed. Let names, status text, and action groups wrap without hiding essential information. Use the existing responsive navigation pattern with one profile home. Reserve space for any sticky selection bar so it cannot obscure rows, errors, or keyboard focus.

Use native labeled controls, a logical keyboard order, and meaningful headings. Selected records need checkbox semantics; active navigation needs an appropriate current-page state. Announce meaningful search/save updates without moving focus. Specify text contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and required UI boundaries, and pointer targets of at least 24 × 24 CSS pixels or an applicable documented exception. Verify 200% text resizing and reflow at 320 CSS pixels. Do not place phone/email searches in URLs or logs merely to retain view state.

**Specification review:** Needs decision on D1. No application or pack files were changed.

| Gate | Status | Evidence and next action |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Context | Pass | Registration job, sources, and exact corrections are mapped above. |
| 2. Direction | Pass | Preserve mode; no invented brand or token values. |
| 3. Hierarchy | Pass | Lookup, unfinished registration, results, and contextual actions have defined priority. |
| 4. States / F3 | Fail | Relevant states are specified, but clear’s saved effect is unresolved. Resolve D1. |
| 5. Integrity / F2 | Pass | Existing treatments are reused; future-phase content is excluded and ambiguous features are flagged. |
| 6. Navigation / F1 | Pass | Expanded-work return route, state retention, and unsaved-work handling are specified. |
| 7. Accessibility | Pass | Measurable specification requirements are stated; implementation checks remain necessary. |
| 8. Motion | Not applicable | No motion was requested or established by the static references. |
| 9. Content and density | Pass | Zero/one/many, long content, wrapping, and narrow-layout rules are specified. |
| 10. Handoff | Pass | Version, decisions, exclusions, acceptance checks, and unresolved scope are explicit. |

Rendered fit, keyboard behavior, contrast measurements, permissions, persistence, and actual recovery remain **Not verified**. They require implementation evidence.
